minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the Pioneer Drive expansion hearing to Aug 14 after moving to approve four waivers.
minutes.summary: The board held a public hearing on a warehouse and office addition for ecological fibers at 40 Pioneer Drive and 98 Leominster Shirley Road. Questions covered curb cuts, parking, traffic, lighting, stormwater and fire protection, and the review engineer went through his comments. A motion to approve the four requested waivers was made and seconded, and the hearing was continued to August 14. Minutes and committee reports followed.
